description: Which ads actually made money — including the rebills and upsells an ad pixel never reports. Rows carry orders, revenue (net of refunds), rebill revenue to date, total, LTV per customer, refund rate, and ROAS where spend has been reported. Group by source, campaign, or ad. Attribution is honest last-click by default (`touch: 'first'` for first-click); it is NOT modelled multi-touch, and the exact definitions come back in the `definitions` field — quote them rather than inventing your own. Revenue with no captured ad click is reported separately as `unattributed_*` and must never be described as 'direct'. Requires the Trace subscription; a 403 says how to start the free trial.
